name: (Path Maiden) Vengeful Frenzy

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text: The path maiden targets a creature within 60 feet that she can see. The target must attempt a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the target is Confused until the end of its next turn, but it can't attack path maidens or itself as the result of this confusion.
